# yyjson

Unmodified `src/yyjson.c`, `src/yyjson.h`, and `LICENSE` from upstream tag
`0.13.0`: https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson/tree/0.13.0

Compiled statically by the root ASTR CMake build. No system JSON package or
runtime shared library is required. The upstream MIT notice is retained in
`LICENSE` and the source files. ASTR's wrapper uses strict JSON, not JSON5.
